title: Max Ginsburg Workshop in Texas
content: This April, Max Ginsburg will be teaching and demonstrating his unique approach to portrait and figure painting in an intensive five day workshop at the Gemini School of Visual Arts just north of Austin, TexasMax has won many awards for his fine art paintings includingBest of Showin this year'sArt Renewal Center Salon. Max taught for many years at the School for Visual Arts in New York City and continues to fill workshops at the Art Students League. This is a rare opportunity to study with Max outside of New York City!Max Ginsburg: Painting From Life in OilApril 2- 6, 2012Venue: Gemini School of Visual ArtContact: Danny Grantdannygrant79@yahoo.com214-454-2172Ginsburg's recent book:Max Ginsburg - RetrospectiveWorkshop Website:www.maxginsburginaustin.blogspot.comBy the way, TheArt Renewal Center Salonhas extended its deadline until March 1.
